Printed edition: The history of the flagellants, or the advantages of discipline; being a paraphrase and commentary on the Historia flagellantium of the Abbé Boileau, ... By somebody who is not doctor of the Sorbonne.  1777, 1777, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_the-history-of-the-flage_de-lolme-jean-louis_1777. The scan does not show the credit of Jean Louis de Lolme, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
